Q.14 / 48·Physics · Mechanics
MED

A ball is released from rest on a smooth incline of angle θ. What is its speed after travelling a distance d along the surface?

A√(2gd sinθ)

B√(2gd cosθ)

C2gd sinθ

Dgd sinθ

Explanation · The component of gravity along the incline is g sinθ. Using v² = 2as with a = g sinθ and s = d.

§ 01 · The examination

Pick the subjects your program requires.

Mathematics is required for every applicant. Physics and Chemistry are required by program; Professional Chinese is only required for Chinese-taught programs. Each Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry paper is 48 multiple-choice questions in 60 minutes, scored out of 100. Most candidates take the exam online at home with a live proctor.

§ 02 · The method

Four things, done consistently.

No mascots, no confetti, no XP. The daily five-question challenge and its streak are as game-like as we get — everything else is a study programme built around a serious exam.

01

Practice by topic

Questions in the bank are scoped by subject and module. Filter to exactly the spot you are weak in, drill ten at a time, see every solution.

02

Spaced repetition

The questions you get wrong come back tomorrow, next week, and next month — at the moments you are about to forget them. The questions you get right leave your rotation.

03

Mock exams, timed

A full 48-question, 60-minute timed mock for the subject your program requires — Mathematics, Physics or Chemistry. Tab-switch counter, auto-grading, and a score out of 100. Built to feel like the day.

04

Honest analytics

Per-module accuracy, week-over-week improvement, the three topics that are costing you the most marks. No streaks for opening the app, no badges for showing up.
